about.title: About AltCare
about.intro: AltCare is a practice management platform built specifically for alternative medicine practitioners — Homeopathy, Ayurveda, Unani, and Herbal medicine — alongside a public knowledge directory of medicines, symptoms, and the institutions that train the next generation of practitioners.
about.clinicsBody: Every clinic's data is row-level isolated. Patients, prescriptions, and payments stay private to the practice that created them.
about.knowledgeBody: The medicine, symptom, and institution catalogs are admin-curated and free to browse — no account required.

practitioners.title: Practice management built for alternative medicine
practitioners.intro: Homeopathy, Ayurveda, Unani, and Herbal Medicine practitioners run their whole clinic on AltCare — patients, appointments, prescriptions, and payments.
practitioners.patientsBody: Full patient records, tags, diagnoses, and history in one place.
practitioners.appointmentsBody: Scheduling, calendar views, and visit notes tied to each patient.
practitioners.prescriptionsBody: A prescription builder with medicine autocomplete and an issue/void workflow.
practitioners.medicinesBody: Start from the global catalog and add your own medicines, aliases, and dosages.
practitioners.paymentsBody: Track payments and generate invoices without leaving the platform.
practitioners.securityBody: Row-level isolation keeps every clinic's data separate and private.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.intro: Every account starts on Free while we review it. Pick the plan you are interested in and tell us more during sign-up, or sign in to see what is available for your account.
pricing.fallbackFreeTagline: Try AltCare in your own chamber
pricing.fallbackPlusTagline: For a working chamber or small clinic
pricing.fallbackProTagline: For established clinics with several doctors
pricing.fallbackEnterpriseTagline: For hospitals, chains and institutions: custom plan and pricing
pricing.fallbackEnterpriseFeature2: Unlimited doctors and large messaging allowances
